major_risks.risk: New aircraft programs such as the 777X, 737-7 and 737-10 involve significant development, testing, certification and production-schedule risk and have already had significant delays.
The company depends on access to capital and financial markets to fund operations and commitments; debt totaled $54.1 billion at 31 December 2025.
Failure to deliver aircraft or raise production rates, or to certify the 737-7 and 737-10, could adversely affect results; cybersecurity and business-disruption risks are also noted.
